definitions.course: A self-contained, first-party learning programme published at learnmasterypath.com/<course>/ with its own syllabus, four progressive levels and lessons. One course is counted once, however many learning paths include it.
definitions.learning_level: One of four ordered stages of a course (Level 1 Entry/Foundation, Level 2 Intermediate, Level 3 Advanced, Level 4 Master), each with its own overview page.
definitions.module: One topic unit within a level. On Mastery Path each module is published as exactly one lesson page, so module and lesson counts are the same; module IDs record the level and position.
definitions.lesson: A published page under level-N/ that teaches one topic and is not a project or capstone. It counts as a qualifying lesson when it returns HTTP 200 and has at least the minimum number of words of published text.
definitions.exercise: A practice task inside a lesson, identified by a section heading that starts with Exercise/Exercises/Practice/Try it. Counted per section; not counted as lessons.
definitions.quiz: A module quiz (per lesson, from the hub's question bank) or a course's final quiz page. Not counted as lessons.
definitions.project: A build task published as its own page (slug contains 'project' or 'capstone'). Counted separately; never included in lesson counts.
definitions.capstone: The final project page of Level 4 (one per course at most). Counted separately from other projects and from lessons.

classification.rule: technology = the course teaches a programming language, software tool, platform, engineering or computing discipline. professional = the course teaches management, leadership, language, accounting/tax or marketing practice, even where software is used.

notes.tally-gst-mastery-path: Accounting and Indian GST practice taught in TallyPrime software; classified professional because the subject is accounting/tax.
notes.workday-mastery-path: Enterprise HR/finance SaaS platform configuration; classified technology (software platform).
notes.agile-mastery-path: Software delivery process; classified professional (process/management), borderline.
notes.ai-manager-mastery-path: Managing AI products and teams; classified professional.
notes.adobe-mastery-path: Creative software suite; classified technology (software tools).
